remarks: Move-in Ready and available for purchase! The Bari is a beautifully designed, Patio Home that blends modern comfort with effortless one-floor living. This newly built home offers 1,687 square feet of thoughtfully planned space. At the heart of the home, a wide-open great room and dining area with soaring 12' ceilings connects to the kitchen creating an inviting space for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen features a spacious island, ample cabinetry, and convenient storage, flowing seamlessly into the great room where a cozy fireplace adds warmth and character. The private primary suite serves as a relaxing retreat, complete with a large walk-in closet and a well-appointed en-suite bath. A second bedroom and full bath provide comfortable accommodations for guests or a home office. First-floor laundry and generous storage throughout add to the home’s everyday convenience. Enjoy the ease of one-level living with direct access from the garage, a welcoming covered front porch, and optional stair access to additional attic storage. There's also a spacious basement for added storage or future added living space. With modern finishes, smart layout, and brand-new construction, The Bari is ready to welcome you home. Enjoy low-maintenance, HOA living in the newest neighborhood in East Amherst, close to shopping & entertainment.
